title: Post-call: BAA availability, PHI handling boundaries & security questionnaire kickoff
text:
Post-call: BAA availability, PHI handling boundaries & security questionnaire kickoff

['From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@healixlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: BAA availability, PHI handling boundaries & security questionnaire kickoff

Hi Alice — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we’re aligned: 

1) BAA availability
- Short answer: Redwood can sign a BAA for Healix Labs for production usage on our Dedicated and Private options. For hosted API we require an allowance in the contract (we support BAA-backed hosted tiers for enterprise customers) — we’ll confirm exact SLA/terms in legal.

2) PHI handling boundaries discussed
- We confirmed that Healix intends to send structured patient notes (PHI) into Redwood for extraction and classification in a production flow.
- Recommended deployment modes for PHI: Dedicated GPU pool with customer-specific key management (preferred), or Private (VPC/on-prem) if Healix requires complete network isolation. Hosted-only options are possible with a BAA + contractual controls but may require traffic segmentation and stricter retention settings.

3) SOC 2 & compliance artifacts
- You asked for SOC 2 type II report and our security pack. Attaching a high-level security pack now; we’ll share SOC 2 report via secure link after NDAs are in place or via your security contact.

4) Vendor security questionnaire
- I’ve attached the questionnaire you shared (Healix_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). Ben will own the technical responses; Lauren will coordinate legal/BAA intake.

Next steps (owners):
- Ben: complete technical questionnaire responses + note backend routing options (Dedicated vs. Private) — target EOD 11/12.
- Lauren: begin legal intake for BAA and routing of contract to Healix procurement — target EOD 11/12.
- Hannah: provide SOC 2 access process and schedule a 30-min technical deep dive for your infra/security team — propose times below.

Proposed times for technical deep dive (PT): Thu 11/12 10:00–10:30, Thu 11/12 14:00–14:30, Fri 11/13 09:00–09:30. Please indicate what works for your security lead.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Pack_v2.pdf (high-level controls), Healix_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (as received)

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Thanks Hannah — that recap is perfect. A few clarifications from our side before we kick off the questionnaire formally: 

- Procurement will need confirmation that BAA execution is standard for Dedicated and Private deployments and the expected turnaround for legal (can you share a sample BAA?).
- Our security team (cc’d) needs to know whether customer-controlled KMS is available for Dedicated, and whether KV cache is persisted to our tenancy in Private.
- SOC 2: we are OK sharing an initial MSSP/secure link to access the report. We would also like to schedule the technical deep dive; Thu 11/12 14:00 PT works for our security lead.

I’ve uploaded the questionnaire we prefer to use (attached). Please confirm who on Redwood will own each section so we can set expectations internally.

Regards,
Alice

Subject: Re: Post-call: BAA availability, PHI handling boundaries & security questionnaire kickoff

Alice — adding the technical context you asked for: 

- KMS: For Dedicated we support customer-managed keys (AWS KMS or GCP CMEK) tied to the instance pool; we can document the key rotation and access controls. For Private (VPC/on-prem) the customer controls the full key lifecycle.
- KV cache persistence: In Dedicated we can offer two modes: ephemeral-only (no cross-request persistence) or tenant-scoped KV cache persisted to encrypted block storage within your tenancy. In Private deployments you fully control persistence.
- Sample BAA: attaching a redacted sample BAA for review (see Redwood_Security_Pack_v2.pdf, section 5). Full legal execution will go through Lauren.

Action: I’ll start filling out the technical tabs in Healix_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx and will flag any items that require product changes or architecture alternatives. Expect my submission by end of day 11/12.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
